name: papercut
title: Papercut
tagline: Layered construction paper brought to life: grain, torn edges, stacked shade strips, a slow camera push and stop-motion paper boil.
description: Short vertical (9:16) explainer style. Every prop is paper: grain, a rough cut edge, a drop shadow, stacked darker/lighter pieces instead of outlines or gradients. Rigid cut-out motion, one taped banner per beat, word-by-word torn tag captions, a boxy paper critter as the hero.
